dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing of the visible 2D body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are predominantly smooth with a slight asymmetrical bulge on the right lateral edge relative to the longitudinal axis.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium grey tone consistent with a juvenile or sub-adult color phase; distinct from mature white.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse patches of slightly darker grey distributed across the dorsal surface, most prominent in the mid-region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the primary medium-grey baseline and localized darker grey pigmented areas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Small, low-contrast dark speckles are visible on the mid-dorsal and posterior-right areas; blowhole is present as a distinct high-contrast circular aperture.
